CONFIDENCE: 0.67
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong benzene ring breathing band at ~1001 cm⁻¹ and aromatic C=C stretches at 1601/1576 cm⁻¹, consistent with a monosubstituted phenyl ring. The medium bands at 1206 and 1167 cm⁻¹ plus the ~1083 cm⁻¹ band fit aryl–O–C/ether C–O stretching features expected for a phenyl ether, while the 683 cm⁻¹ and 514 cm⁻¹ bands are compatible with C–Cl stretching/bending in the chloroethyl side chain (supported by the general C–Cl stretch region in GFQ-046). The CH-stretching envelope at 2921 cm⁻¹ (aliphatic) and ~3073 cm⁻¹ (aromatic) is as expected for an aryl ether with an aliphatic chain (GFQ-003). The absence of a clear OH stretch near 3200–3700 cm⁻¹ disfavors alcohol candidates (e.g., 1 and 4).
